import json,gzip,glob,os
files=sorted(glob.glob('/var/ossec/logs/archives/2026/Nov/*json*'))+['/var/ossec/logs/archives/archives.json']
for path in files:
 if not os.path.isfile(path):continue
 print('FILE',path)
 op=gzip.open if path.endswith('.gz') else open
 with op(path,'rt',encoding='utf8') as f:
  for line in f:
   try:d=json.loads(line)
   except:continue
   if d.get('agent',{}).get('name')!='windows-user':continue
   w=d.get('data',{}).get('win',{});s=w.get('system',{})
   if ((s.get('providerName')=='Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog' and s.get('eventID') in ('1102','104')) or (s.get('channel')=='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' and s.get('eventID') in ('1116','1117','1118','1119','5000','5001'))):print(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False))
PYCODE
